turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are things with you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A bit tired today, but okay.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Help. I put way too much salt in my lentil soup.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Okay, it's fixable. Can you add more liquid, like water or unsalted stock?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yeah, but it'll get really thin.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then add more lentils or a potato to bulk it up and thicken it again. Simmer until they're soft.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I heard you can drop a raw potato in to soak up salt.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's mostly a myth. It absorbs a little salty liquid, but really it's the dilution that helps.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh. Well, I'll try more lentils

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Good plan. A squeeze of lemon at the end also makes salty food taste more balanced.
